## 5. DRAWINGSANDSPECIFICATIONS

## 5.1 SubmissionandApproval

The periods referred to in Sub-Clause 5.1 of Conditions of Contract (Submission and Approval)areasfollows:

- >The period for the review (approve / disapprove) of drawings and / or materials submissions is 14 days.
- >The period for inspection requests is 24 hours in advance.
- The period for the review (approve / disapprove) re-submission of drawings and / or materials is 7 days.

## 5.7 As-builtDrawings,OperationsandMaintenanceManuals

The period referred to in Sub-Clause 5.7 of Conditions of Contract for Asbuilt Drawings, Operations and Maintenance Manuals is fourteen days (14) days.

The ContractorsubmittaltoAsBuilt drawings,Catalogues,Operation and Maintenance manuals must be in three hard copies and one Softcopy in itsoriginalProgramformat.Suchsubmittalshouldbeprior tothe ContractorrequestfortheTakingOverCertificateforeachphaseand/or part of the Works.Failure by the Contractor to fulfill this requirement, then the Employer shall have theright to withhold the issue of the Taking Over Certificate.
